# Pilot installation for consultants

Before starting, obtain the approved pilot distribution link from the product
owner and use the authorized Microsoft Edge work profile.

1. Open the approved Edge Add-ons pilot link.
2. Select **Get** and approve the displayed extension permissions.
3. Open Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central.
4. Open BC Process Studio from the Edge toolbar and start the
   agreed sandbox process.
5. Stop recording, open Review, inspect the result, and save the project.

The production pilot must not use Developer mode, **Load unpacked**, GitHub,
Node.js, npm, or the repository `dist` folder.

To verify the installed version, open `edge://extensions`, locate BC Process
Studio, and read its version. Edge normally updates it
automatically. If an update appears stuck, finish recording, close all Edge
windows normally, reopen Edge, and check again. If still incorrect, report the
browser version, extension version, session identifier, recording health and
frame diagnostics—never screenshots or entered business values by default.
